Enumerate every distinct source payment and every actual source-established plan event. The host names each row. Each syntactically distinct paid event is a separate payment row, including oppositely directed payments between the same people. Work is not itself a payment, and a person is not a plan merely because native code tests plan_(person). Read only event_kind.
Read facts only. The host names each enumerated source row; do not generate an event ID. Do not infer missing dates, people or places. Complete scans enumerate every relevant source record. Ambiguity is unread. Return the named relation wrapper.
